-- guard fixture migration 0005 (already applied -- exists on origin/main).
-- SECOND false-positive shape (CodeRabbit, PR #123 review): this is
-- origin/main ADVANCING after this branch forked, with its own commit
-- editing a migration that already existed at the merge base. This
-- branch (head/head2) never touches 0005 at all. A SYMMETRIC git log
-- range walks this commit too (it is reachable from origin/main, just
-- not from HEAD) and, since 0005 genuinely exists at the merge base,
-- the base-existence check does not save it -- flagged as a violation
-- on a branch that made no such edit. An ASYMMETRIC $MERGE_BASE..HEAD
-- range never reaches this commit at all, because it only walks commits
-- reachable from HEAD.
